workbook_path: data/Hungry F&B Database.Public Access 2026-10-17 Verified Menu Catalogue Refresh 40.xlsx
method: Read-only first-party source pass. Captured live operator nutrition page, extracted exact item-image src/name pairs, fetched ten new unique JPEG assets, checked HTTP/MIME/SHA, visually inspected each image, and deduped against current Image Candidates URLs. No delivery platform, stock/placeholder/generated source, paid source, Mapbox, or workbook edits.

source_pages.verified_fact: Official outlet listing includes Raffles City Shopping Centre, 252 North Bridge Road, #B1-L44; directory exact-name match set is 10 records.

source_pages.rights_fact: Website says materials are owned by/licensed to it and reproduction prohibited except in accordance with copyright notice; no open reuse grant identified.

directory_match.method: exact case-insensitive F&B Name = The Soup Spoon

held_sources.source: KFC Singapore official Search Box/app menu interface
held_sources.reason: Official current menu is indexed and has current item names/prices, but the site shell requires JS; its static image CDN returned 403 for tested direct asset paths, so no direct, verified asset URL proposal was recorded.

scope_limits: All candidates are review-only; no persistent reproduction permission.
No branch-level availability was inferred from brand-level first-party menu assets.
Displayed menu variant names were taken from the current live first-party calculator page, which does not show prices.
Photo files were read for identity inspection only and not added to the repository or workbook.
